tools.name: analyst_ingest
tools.description: Store data or findings into the analyst's long-term memory.

tools.name: analyst_search_memory
tools.description: Search stored intelligence by topic or keyword.

tools.name: analyst_create_dashboard
tools.description: Create a named dashboard for an analysis project.

tools.name: analyst_list_dashboards
tools.description: List the user's active analyst dashboards.

tools.name: analyst_fetch_data
tools.description: Fetch any URL/API now; returns the raw response.

tools.name: analyst_discover_sources
tools.description: Search the catalog of vetted free data APIs.

tools.name: analyst_schedule_collection
tools.description: Create a recurring data collection job on a cron schedule.

tools.name: analyst_list_collections
tools.description: Active data collections with status and schedule.

tools.name: analyst_stop_collection
tools.description: Stop (pause) a scheduled data collection.

tools.name: analyst_track_hypothesis
tools.description: Create, update or close a hypothesis (id updates; omit creates).

tools.name: analyst_get_hypotheses
tools.description: Hypotheses by dashboard, status or conviction.

tools.name: analyst_create_tracker
tools.description: Create a tracker: market_watchlist (equityTickers, occSymbols), portfolio, experiment, prediction.

tools.name: analyst_list_trackers
tools.description: List trackers (incl. market_watchlist), optionally by dashboard.

tools.name: analyst_patch_tracker
tools.description: Update tracker name/config; tickers merge, remove* lists remove.

tools.name: analyst_record_decision
tools.description: Log a decision with reasoning on a tracker.

tools.name: analyst_get_tracker
tools.description: A tracker's current state and recent decisions.

tools.name: analyst_schedule_analysis
tools.description: Schedule a recurring analysis of a dashboard.

tools.name: analyst_research
tools.description: Web search for breaking news; results saved to memory.

tools.name: analyst_setup_tracking
tools.description: Track a stock, sector, thesis or event (research, watchlist).

tools.name: analyst_market_list_hypotheses
tools.description: Registered backtest hypotheses.

tools.name: analyst_market_backfill_bars
tools.description: Store OHLCV bars (idempotent); provider=yahoo for off-universe daily equities; futures auto-route.

tools.name: analyst_market_snapshot_chain
tools.description: Store the options chain (Greeks, IV) for underlying + expiration.

tools.name: analyst_market_run_backtest
tools.description: Backtest a hypothesis on stored data (persists the run).

tools.name: analyst_market_get_backtest
tools.description: A stored backtest run by id (trades, equity curve, metrics).

tools.name: analyst_market_list_accounts
tools.description: Paper and connected broker accounts, including the managed paper book the desk trades. isLivePaperBook marks the book that receives paper orders. managedPaper marks an enabled managed paper book you can read by id.

tools.name: analyst_market_create_paper_account
tools.description: Create a paper account; offer startingCash 1k–100k.

tools.name: analyst_market_propose_trade
tools.description: Propose a trade for approval: reasoning, projected delta/vega/premium. Live: admins only.

tools.name: analyst_market_list_proposals
tools.description: Trade proposals (pending and past), optionally by status.

tools.name: analyst_market_get_proposal_status
tools.description: Proposal status (pending, approved, rejected, expired, executed).

tools.name: analyst_market_cancel_proposal
tools.description: Withdraw a pending proposal.

tools.name: analyst_get_notification_prefs
tools.description: Read proposal-alert channel preferences.

tools.name: analyst_set_notification_prefs
tools.description: Update proposal-alert channels (browser, push, email).

tools.name: analyst_market_submit_order
tools.description: Submit an order (loops: prefer propose_trade). Futures: kind=futures, symbol=ES.c.0, paper. Spreads: kind=multi_leg, symbol=underlying, buy=debit/sell=credit, legs=[{occSymbol,side,ratio?}]. Live: admins only.

tools.name: analyst_market_list_orders
tools.description: Broker orders for an account, optionally by status. Omit accountId to read the live paper book. Pass an id from list_accounts to read that book's orders, including a managed paper book.

tools.name: analyst_market_get_positions
tools.description: Account summary (cash, equity, buying power) and open positions with P&L. Omit accountId to read the live paper book. Pass an id from list_accounts to read that book, including a managed paper book.

tools.name: analyst_market_personal_paper_read
tools.description: Your paper profile: holdings, cash, P&L. Read-only.

tools.name: analyst_market_personal_paper_review
tools.description: Research review of your personal paper portfolio from desk notes; read-only.

tools.name: analyst_market_personal_paper_from_csv
tools.description: CSV paper profile: preview, show the user the rows, wait for their OK, then expectedKey.

tools.name: analyst_market_read_bars
tools.description: Stored OHLCV bars (no live fetch). Futures alias ES.c.0.

tools.name: analyst_market_list_futures_instruments
tools.description: Futures specs: multiplier, tick, session, roll, margins.

tools.name: analyst_market_backfill_trades
tools.description: Store futures prints (ES.c.0), ≤7d; gaps only; repeat from=continueFrom until null. Cost cap: admin + confirmCost.

tools.name: analyst_market_read_trades
tools.description: Stored futures prints (ts, price, size, side); default last hour, ≤50000.

tools.name: analyst_market_build_bars
tools.description: Bars from stored prints (≤7d): renko|range (ticks), volume, cvd, profile.

tools.name: analyst_market_run_sweep
tools.description: Sweep a strategy grid (≤24 points, ≤92d): OOS, walk-forward, stability.

tools.name: analyst_market_list_sweep
tools.description: Recent strategy sweeps, or one sweep's candidates (sweepId).

tools.name: analyst_market_indicator_series
tools.description: Indicator series over stored bars; warmedUp=false = too little history.

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_screen
tools.description: Ranked chart-pattern setups on stored futures bars.

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_paper_book
tools.description: Paper futures book: positions, margin, limits, fills, variation.

tools.name: analyst_market_live_status
tools.description: Futures feed health: bar age, lag, reconnects.

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_levels
tools.description: Futures gamma levels, regime, expected move, provenance.

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_brief
tools.description: Futures section of the latest daily brief.

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_events
tools.description: Market events, entry blackouts and circuit breaker state.

tools.name: analyst_market_desk_view
tools.description: Move the user's open Trading Desk to show them something; target refs tab:, sub:, card:, proposal:, account:, report:, spec:, arm:, alert:, run:, idea:, position:<acct>:<SYM>; chart = futures chart view; returns whether the desk is open and a link.

tools.name: analyst_market_chart_focus
tools.description: Focus the desk futures chart (alias of analyst_market_desk_view focus with chart); returns the view link.

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_strategy
tools.description: Strategy-lab reads. op: list (status) | get (specId, version) | compare backtest vs paper | research tape stats ≤92d (instrument, from, to, indicators).

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_strategy_write
tools.description: Strategy-lab writes, paper; reason logged. op: create (body, name, hypothesis) → strategyKey | update (specId, body) | fork (specId|codeStrategyKey) | retire (specId) | paper_start (specId, portfolioId, version) | paper_stop (experimentId|specId).

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_lab
tools.description: Lab paper accounts, rules, cycles; changes need reason. op: accounts_list | account_create (label, fields{startingCash 1k–100k, riskPerTradePct}) | account_set_available lend (portfolioId, available) | account_adjust lab-made (portfolioId, fields{addCash|setCash|resetCash, exposureMultiple, contractsPerInstrument, contractsByInstrument, sizingMode, riskPerTradePct}) | settings (fields to set; none = read) | cycle (digest).

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_alerts
tools.description: Your futures alerts; notify, never trade. op: list (rules, fires, catalog) | create (rule{instrument, kind indicator|pattern|price, indicator|pattern|level, condition, timeframe, direction, channels, cooldownSec}) | delete|pause|resume (ruleId).

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_arms
tools.description: Paper strategy arms. op: list (portfolioId) | arm code strategy (portfolioId, strategyKey, instrument; specs: paper_start) | pause|resume|disarm|flatten (armId; flatten also closes: returns a confirmToken, show the user, resend with it).

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_risk_profile
tools.description: Paper futures risk profile (rules, meters, breaches), own accounts. op: get | set (preset|fields) | reset evaluation.

tools.name: analyst_market_desk_read
tools.description: Desk reports. what: reports (ticker, tradeDate, limit, canonicalOnly) | report|debate|debate_context (reportId) | paper_trades|reflections (ticker, limit) | cost_summary|outcome_metrics (from, to, ticker) | judge_calibration | entry_gate_funnel (days) | sentiment (ticker).

tools.name: analyst_market_desk_state
tools.description: What the user has open on the Trading Desk (no read) or one desk view by read; params: symbol, accountId, portfolioId, runId, ids, limit ≤50, from, to.

tools.name: analyst_market_desk_action
tools.description: Desk changes, paper. help (params.action) lists fields. Deletes, resets, costly runs return a confirmToken: show the user, then resend with it.

tools.name: analyst_market_futures_events_ingest
tools.description: Refresh the economic calendar. 3 per 5 minutes and 12/day.

tools.name: analyst_market_import_paper_csv
tools.description: CSV into a paper account; preview unless confirm. Rebalance closes unlisted; use the preview confirmToken.

tools.name: analyst_market_read_chain_asof
tools.description: Options chain as of a past date from stored snapshots.

tools.name: analyst_market_register_platform_schedules
tools.description: Admin: Register desk schedules (idempotent).

targets.description: Default ['portfolio']; add 'schwab' after full desk setup.

tools.name: analyst_market_run_desk_debate
tools.description: Desk analysis and debate on a ticker (own paper; live needs an admin).

tools.name: analyst_get_daily_report
tools.description: Daily intelligence report for YYYY-MM-DD or 'latest'.

tools.name: analyst_list_daily_reports
tools.description: Recent global daily reports, newest first.

tools.name: analyst_run_daily_report
tools.description: Admin: generate the global daily report (idempotent unless force).

tools.name: analyst_get_daily_schedule
tools.description: Read the daily report schedule.

tools.name: analyst_schedule_daily_pipeline
tools.description: Admin: set the daily intelligence schedule.

tools.name: analyst_clear_daily_schedule
tools.description: Admin: cancel the daily schedule.

tools.name: analyst_schedule_weekly_pipeline
tools.description: Admin: set the Saturday deep-dive schedule.

tools.name: analyst_insiders_recent
tools.description: Recent congressional trades, Form 4 insider trades and 13D/13G stake filings. Read-only.

tools.name: analyst_insiders_ingest
tools.description: Admin: ingest new insider filings (congress, Form 4, 13D/13G). 6/hr.

tools.name: analyst_get_daily_addendum
tools.description: Daily addendum for a date or 'latest'; 404 = none yet.

tools.name: analyst_run_daily_addendum
tools.description: Run today's addendum (force=true reruns); owner-only, 5/hr.

tools.name: analyst_fear_greed
tools.description: Current Fear & Greed score (0-100) and its inputs.

tools.name: analyst_log_prediction
tools.description: Log a falsifiable prediction (future expiresAt). Options: optionsMath (ev>0, IV, break-even, R:R).

tools.name: analyst_grade_prediction
tools.description: Grade a prediction correct, wrong or partial, with a note.

tools.name: analyst_get_prediction_stats
tools.description: Prediction stats (win rate, score); grades expired ones.

tools.name: analyst_list_predictions
tools.description: A dashboard's predictions, optionally by status.

tools.name: analyst_run_self_grade
tools.description: Grade expired predictions; win rate, biases; saves calibration.

tools.name: analyst_add_pattern
tools.description: Add a pattern to the dashboard library.

tools.name: analyst_list_patterns
tools.description: A dashboard's patterns with accuracy stats.

tools.name: analyst_record_pattern_application
tools.description: Record a pattern application (correct | wrong) with a note.

tools.name: analyst_market_trade_ideas
tools.description: Ranked trade ideas from every desk source, desk-scored. action: list | get (params.id: why, evidence) | scan (rebuild) | paper_trade (params.id, accountId?) → paper proposal you approve | whatif (params.id): past analogs.
